# P8C Deployment Gate — DRAFT (NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_EXECUTION)

Дата: 2026-11-03. Исполнитель подготовки: PRIMARY HERMES. Status: DRAFT.

```text
DEPLOYMENT_GATE=NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_EXECUTION
NETPOL_APPROVED_FOR_APPLY=NO · PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_DEPLOYMENT=NOT_AUTHORIZED
```

## DEP-01 — prerequisites, порядок S0–S4, rollback (восстановлено)

Prerequisites (до S1): accepted candidate SHA; current baseline/S3/WAL proof (PR-3/6 + HC-ARCH-STATE +
RD-01 pg_stat_archiver); accepted CI run + verified source/image digest + private pull readiness;
Owner-provisioned auth/pull credentials; разрешённые объекты ниже.

```text
S0  baseline (условный): spec.instances=3, status.instances=3, status.readyInstances=3, Ready=True.
S1  apply p8c-cnpg-existing-flows (полный CNPG allowlist).
S2a apply baseline-default-deny-all;  S2b apply baseline-allow-dns-egress.
S3  apply p8c-portal-flows + p8c-migrator-flows (политики ДО workloads) → Deployment/Job;
    migrator ДО application readiness; migration → application readiness; один verified digest.
S4  apply p8c-portal-dataplane-flows → Gateway ПОСЛЕДНИМ. Экспозиция: риск начинается с создания
    Gateway; Programmed/LB IP не гарантия отсутствия внешнего доступа; cleanup generated Service/Pods
    (обе owning labels) проверяется ДО снятия dataplane egress.
Rollback: только вновь созданные объекты по UID-precondition, no-overwrite; S4→S3→S2b→S2a→S1→S0;
default-deny/allow-dns снимать ДО existing-flows; migration без destructive down-SQL; CNPG не трогать;
NetPol rollback не удаляет existing workloads.
```

## DEP-03 — RBAC matrix (source rbac.yaml)

Cluster-scope (ClusterRole portal-platform-reader → CRB для SA portal-reader) даёт **cluster-wide**
namespaced read (get/list) на: nodes, persistentvolumes, pods, services, persistentvolumeclaims, events
(core); storageclasses (storage.k8s.io); deployments/statefulsets/daemonsets/replicasets (apps);
jobs/cronjobs (batch); endpointslices (discovery.k8s.io); volumesnapshots (snapshot.storage.k8s.io);
nodes/pods (metrics.k8s.io). Это НЕ «только portal+velero».

Named (GET-only, не list): clusters[portal-db], scheduledbackups[portal-db-daily], objectstores
[portal-db-backup] (postgresql.cnpg.io/barmancloud.cnpg.io); gateways[portal-gateway], httproutes[portal]
(gateway.networking.k8s.io). backups (postgresql.cnpg.io) get+list. velero.io backupstoragelocations/
backups/restores get+list (namespace velero).

Denied (не выдаётся): secrets, configmaps, serviceaccounts/token, pods/exec, pods/proxy, create/update/
patch/delete, любые resourceNames вне named set.

**Representative SAR rows (operator, не actual mutation; ≤20 явных случаев):**

| subject | group/resource/subresource | verb | ns/name | expected | timeout | artifact |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SA portal-reader | "" / nodes | get | cluster | allow | 15s | sar-node.json |
| SA portal-reader | "" / pods | list | cluster | allow | 15s | sar-pods.json |
| SA portal-reader | postgresql.cnpg.io / clusters | get | portal/portal-db | allow | 15s | sar-cluster.json |
| SA portal-reader | postgresql.cnpg.io / clusters | list | portal | deny | 15s | sar-cluster-list.json |
| SA portal-reader | gateway.networking.k8s.io / gateways | get | portal/portal-gateway | allow | 15s | sar-gw.json |
| SA portal-reader | "" / secrets | get | portal/portal-db-app | deny | 15s | sar-secret.json |
| SA portal-reader | "" / pods/exec | create | portal | deny | 15s | sar-exec.json |
| SA portal-reader | apps / deployments | create | portal | deny | 15s | sar-deploy-create.json |

Это representative runtime checking; полное source-rule сравнение отдельно. SAR-POST — будущая
bounded operator-активность, НЕ разрешение Portal создавать reviews и НЕ destructive mutation test.

## DEP-04 — Migration, TLS, API, events (числа)

- Migration: version=1, checksum=`53e37c762d9efd4f8985ad848d33a6a3604c4554e65accb39429d14d62dfdbe7`;
  proof = Job exit 0 → ledger query `SELECT version, checksum ... ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1` →
  VerifySchema (main.go). Не только exit 0.
- DB TLS verify-full: config DBHost/port 5432, sslmode verify-full, sslrootcert /etc/portal/db/ca.crt,
  SNI portal-db-rw.portal.svc, MinVersion TLS1.2, InsecureSkipVerify=false, Fallbacks=0 (poolConfig).
  Proof = успешная миграция/VerifySchema через pool (иначе connect fail). `/readyz` 200 ≠ verify-full
  proof; `ssl=true` ≠ hostname verification. App Ping = store.Ping (3s).
- 11 API (server.go): /api/v1/{health,summary,nodes,workloads,pods,services,storage,backups,database,
  metrics,events} — Basic Auth (401/200), GET/HEAD only. mgmt /livez,/readyz,/startupz на 8081 (НЕ
  открывать через внешний Service; `/healthz` отсутствует).
- Events: timeline_events (dedup_key UNIQUE, TTL 7d, cap 50000, prune ≤1000/statement), observation_batches
  (TTL 7d, cap 20000); readback ListEvents keyset (id DESC, afterID). Без искусственных K8s событий.
- Bounds (accepted plan): request timeout min(15s, remaining W); W=60/30/120s; I=10/5/10s; N≤6;
  **Gateway: W=120s, I=10s, N≤12 в ОДНОМ hard window** (не 12×120s).

## 5. Bootstrap — private-before

```text
DESIGN_CHOICE=SEPARATE_GITHUB_ACTIONS_PRIVATE_SEED_GATE
```
Основной release сохраняет private-before. Если точный private package с корректной repository-association
и доступом уже существует и доказан evidence — seed не нужен. Иначе: отдельный one-shot Owner-authorized
bootstrap workflow с автоматически выдаваемым GITHUB_TOKEN, точной identity `ghcr.io/dedvmedved-dot/otus-diplom-portal`
и явно идентифицированным seed artifact/tag. Seed — НЕ Portal release, НЕ accepted image, НЕ deployable;
после создания записать digest/source/private visibility/repository association, затем снова private-before
для основного release. 404 ≠ доказанное отсутствие (permissions могут скрывать); ambiguous identity/access → STOP.
Без PAT, без workflow-token, без public-package workaround. Reference:
https://docs.github.com/en/packages/working-with-a-github-packages-registry/working-with-the-container-registry
https://docs.github.com/en/packages/learn-github-packages/configuring-a-packages-access-control-and-visibility

# P8C Runtime-Readiness Gate — DRAFT (NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_EXECUTION)

Дата: 2026-11-03. Исполнитель подготовки: PRIMARY HERMES. Status: DRAFT.
METRIC_SOURCE_CHOICE=ACCEPTED_SOURCE_ONLY (cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_*).

```text
RUNTIME_READINESS_GATE=NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_EXECUTION
PHASE2_NEW_RUN_APPROVED=NO · NETPOL_APPROVED_FOR_APPLY=NO
```

## RD-01 — WAL observation: DESIGN_SELECTED / EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED

```text
DESIGN_CHOICE=OPERATOR_PRIMARY_BOUND_DIRECT_EXPORTER
ACCESS_METHOD=DESIGN_SELECTED / EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED
```

- actor: авторизованный operator на node-01 (НЕ Portal application), через принятый key-only path.
- binding: named `portal/portal-db` Cluster `.status.currentPrimary` → named Pod в portal → валидация
  cluster identity/UID/текущего Pod IP → фиксированный HTTP `9187/metrics`. Каждый metric-sample
  обрамляется metadata GET (Cluster + Pod); role/UID/IP/restart/reset change инвалидирует сравнение.
- transport: HTTP (source-backed, config.go MetricsServiceURL + P8B). TLS НЕ подразумевается; DB TLS
  contract (Service:5432 verify-full) НЕ ослабляется. Без redirects/exec/port-forward/SQL/new
  Service/new collector/Secret read. Connectivity failure = INCONCLUSIVE/STOP (без альтернативных путей).

**Согласованный бюджет (одна таблица):**

| Параметр | Значение |
|---|---|
| stages | S0 (baseline) + S1, S2a, S2b, S3, S4 (post-step) = 6 |
| samples | 1 metric sample/stage = 6 metric GET; 2 metadata GET (Cluster+Pod) на sample = 12 metadata GET |
| total GET | 18 (12 metadata + 6 metrics) |
| per-request timeout | 5s (metrics + metadata) |
| per-stage hard deadline | 30s (от первого metadata GET до завершения metric GET) |
| retry | НЕТ (каждый GET один attempt; timeout → INCONCLUSIVE/STOP стадии) |
| max body | metadata GET ≤ 256 KiB (typed projection), metric GET ≤ 1 MiB |
| total bytes | 6×1 MiB + 12×256 KiB = 9 MiB |
| total wall-time | ≤ 6 × 30s = 180s (при последовательных стадиях) |
| projected metadata | Cluster: name/uid/status.currentPrimary/conditions; Pod: name/uid/labels(role)/status.podIP/status.containerStatuses |

**Verdict (серии cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_*):**
- PASS: archived_count вырос И last_archived_time > baseline-значение этапа, И last_archived_time
  свидетельствует о СВЕЖЕМ post-step архиве (GET-time ≠ archive-time; clock/freshness tolerance: last_archived_time
  в пределах (baseline, now], иначе INCONCLUSIVE).
- FAIL: failed_count вырос ИЛИ last_failed_time продвинулся (не маскировать за ростом archived_count).
- INCONCLUSIVE/STOP: parse error/NaN; HTTP/network timeout; stats_reset_time изменился; role/UID/restart;
  idle (нет роста — не force WAL, не бесконечное ожидание).
- primary-only sampling — выбранная политика сравнения; pinned query также допускает archive_mode=always
  (не утверждать «meaningful ТОЛЬКО на primary»). CNPG ARCH-STATE остаётся отдельным от свежего WAL progress.
- archive_command = ограниченный proxy; НЕ независимый S3 readback, НЕ DNS proof.

## RD-02 — baseline (PR-3/5/6 + HC-*) — без изменений

PR-3/5/6 + HC-* по accepted plan; bounds наследуются (request timeout min(15s, remaining W); W=60/30/120s;
I=10/5/10s; N≤6; Gateway W=120s/I=10s/N≤12 в одном окне). NOT_AUTHORIZED. Execution wrapper — отдельный prerequisite.

## Статус
```text

METRIC_SOURCE_CHOICE=ACCEPTED_SOURCE_ONLY
ACCESS_METHOD=DESIGN_SELECTED (OPERATOR_PRIMARY_BOUND_DIRECT_EXPORTER) / EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED
EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES: безопасный execution wrapper (metadata+metric GET projection).
PHASE2_NEW_RUN_APPROVED=NO · NETPOL_APPROVED_FOR_APPLY=NO · P8C=NOT_FINAL_ACCEPTED
```

# (1) FIRST policy selecting existing CNPG pods: one object with the FULL
#     candidate ingress+egress allowlist (accepted source, NOT runtime-verified).
#     Applying it already isolates CNPG pods.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: p8c-cnpg-existing-flows
  namespace: portal
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
      cnpg.io/podRole: instance
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
  ingress:
  # CNPG peer replication + instance-manager
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
          cnpg.io/podRole: instance
    ports:
    - port: 5432
    - port: 8000
  # CNPG operator instance-manager calls (reconcile/switchover/restart)
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: cnpg-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: cloudnative-pg
    ports:
    - port: 8000
  # Portal app: application DB (5432) + CNPG metrics scrape (9187)
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal
    ports:
    - port: 5432
    - port: 9187
  # Migrator Job: application DB bootstrap (5432)
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal-migrator
    ports:
    - port: 5432
  egress:
  # DNS (selector-based, UDP+TCP 53)
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-dns
    ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — ClusterIP tuple (pre-DNAT): 10.96.0.1/32:443 only.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.96.0.1/32
    ports:
    - port: 443
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — endpoint tuples (post-DNAT): three exact /32:6443, not a /24.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.101/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.102/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.103/32
    ports:
    - port: 6443
      protocol: TCP
  # S3 (SeaweedFS) — per-instance sidecar backup/WAL egress (historical candidate, freshness precheck pending)
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.143.10/32
    ports:
    - port: 443
      protocol: TCP
  # CNPG peer replication + instance-manager (egress)
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
          cnpg.io/podRole: instance
    ports:
    - port: 5432
    - port: 8000

    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — ClusterIP tuple (pre-DNAT): 10.96.0.1/32:443 only.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.96.0.1/32
    ports:
    - port: 443
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — endpoint tuples (post-DNAT): three exact /32:6443, not a /24.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.101/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.102/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.103/32
    ports:
    - port: 6443
      protocol: TCP
  # CNPG app DB
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
    ports:
    - port: 5432
  # CNPG metrics
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
    ports:
    - port: 9187

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: p8c-migrator-flows
  namespace: portal
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal-migrator
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  # DNS only — migrator has no Kubernetes API egress.
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-dns
    ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
    ports:
    - port: 5432
---
# (4) Envoy dataplane policy: dataplane -> Portal (8080) and its xDS/upstreams.
#     Deployed with the Gateway (namespace of the dataplane pods). Egress-only.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: p8c-portal-dataplane-flows
  namespace: envoy-gateway-system
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: proxy
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: envoy-gateway
      app.kubernetes.io/name: envoy
      gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name: portal-gateway
      gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-namespace: portal
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  # xDS to Envoy Gateway control-plane (required for dataplane config).
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: envoy-gateway-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          control-plane: envoy-gateway
    ports:
    - port: 18000
  # backend (Portal UI) via Service portal:80 -> container 8080.
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: portal
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal
    ports:
    - port: 8080
  # DNS
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-dns
    ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
